name: vq1_partial
description: CROPPED/PARTIAL gate arm: camera CLOSE (1.5-7 m) with the boresight pushed ~half-FOV off the target so the gate spills over a frame edge -- only a quadrant/half in view, the gate CENTRE often OFF-frame. Goes past terminal_approach (which keeps >=3 inner + centre in-frame): here the inner corners themselves leave frame. Teaches the detector to FIRE on partial gates so the existing >=3-corner P3P recovers the off-frame centre; the 2-corner case is a downstream geometric solve. Additive arm -- blend into the merged dataset. See vq2-cropped-gate-offframe-keypoint-limit.
